easyPrerequisites:
ZImone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
There is a black card in your graveyard.
description:
Activate Xiahou Dun by sacrificing it.
When Xiahou Dun dies, Yedora triggers, returning Xiahou Dun from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Xiahou Dun enters the battlefield, Zimone triggers.
Holding priority, activate Xiahou Dun by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning Xiahou Dun face-up.
Repeat.
Resolve all Xiahou Dun abilities.
